assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated illustration for a BAIT game card, a new subject using the attached bomb emblem only as a visual style reference. Limited arcade-sprite palette. Flat pixel-art shading, no smooth gradients, no blur, no tiny speckled details. Centered square composition, whole subject visible, generous transparent margin about 16 percent. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no scenery, no ground, no cast-shadow plane, no frame, no card border, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Illustration only; typography will be drawn in the app. Subject: one large triangular PIZZA slice, golden crust with bright cream melted cheese, three chunky orange-red pepperoni circles, a single short stretch of cheese hanging from the point. Slightly tilted three-quarter view. Big simple silhouette, appetizing playful arcade icon. No face, no plate, no hands.
